what: The Hero artwork starts split into four layers. From the back layer forward, each drops from 3x to 1x in turn (1.3·1.2·1.1·1s, staggered .3·.08·.16·.24s, fade-in .3s). Once all have landed, the big text pieces on the layers rise from 8rem below at .08s stagger. On scroll, each layer is pushed down at a different speed (back .9 → front .1 × 200px) to create depth

options.durs: Drop length per layer (seconds, comma-separated), default 1.3,1.2,1.1,1 — the last value is used if short
options.gaps: Delay for each layer from the start of the previous one (seconds, comma-separated), default .3,.08,.16,.24
options.delay: Time from the document fully loading until start (s), default .4
options.rates: Parallax rate per layer (comma-separated, from the back layer), default .9,.8,.5,.1 (phones use rates-sp)
options.rates-sp: Scale at widths up to 767px, default 1.3,1.1,.8,.3
options.rise: Distance the text pieces float up (CSS length), default 8rem
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Layers — ordered back to front. Required
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Large text piece on the layer (if any)

note: The layer is an absolutely positioned panel filling the section (scales up around 30% from the top). Parallax runs while the section passes over the top of the screen (top top → bottom top)
